name: The thank-you letter
description: Short and direct. Three chapters to say what someone did for you, why it mattered, and that you noticed.

defaults.title: Thank you
defaults.closingMessage: I don't think I ever said it properly. So: thank you.

copy.envelope.title: Something overdue.
copy.envelope.subtitle: It won't take long to read.
copy.welcome.subtitle: This is short, and I meant all of it.
copy.closing.title: So: thank you.

content.text: Start with the specific thing. Not "you've always been there" — the actual afternoon, the actual phone call, the actual favour.
Tell them what would have happened otherwise. That's the bit people rarely hear, and it's the bit that lands.
Replace this with what they said at the time, if you remember it.
content.attribution: You, not making a fuss about it

content.text: No favour to ask, nothing attached. Just that.

finalSurprise.question: How are you feeling right now?
finalSurprise.successMessage: Good. That's exactly what I was hoping for.
